trophies.guide: Earn every other trophy. There is no shortcut: finish the story, clear the 100% checklist for A Long Road, and sweep up the activities and collectibles. Save it for last — it pops the moment the 54th trophy lands.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play through the opening until the Gone Fishing mission is done. It is an early story beat, so just follow the main path — no detour needed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Story only, unmissable as long as you keep playing the main missions.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Keep following the story; the chapter trophy pops at the final mission of the chapter.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Same as the other chapter trophies — play the story through.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. The last chapter trophy before the finale.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. This is the story finale — finish the last mission and the gold is yours.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the Breakfast Run mission. A story mission — play through it and the trophy follows.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist. A story heist mission; finish it to unlock.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the Child's Play mission. Story only.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the Headliners mission. Story only.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the VCIA Takedown mission. Story only — expect a set-piece at the airport.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory. Story only.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. This is the big one — the completion checklist. Work through the story, all activities, collectibles and side content. PowerPyx rates the platinum around 200 hours with a single playthrough enough; treat this as the long tail after the story ends.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts. Stunts are jumps, near-misses, airtime and drifts — they add up fast if you drive aggressively. Farm them in a fast car on the highway: jumps off ramps and near-miss traffic chains count. Check the Challenges menu to see your count.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of activity once. Dip into each activity the game offers — a race, a fishing spot, the shooting range, an arcade game, a drone race and the rest. One try each is enough; you do not need to win them all.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Get a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge. Learn each range's scoring (accuracy and speed both matter), use a steady weapon, and replay the ones you miss. Gold on every challenge is the bar — silver will not do.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a drone race at every Top Fun location. Find each Top Fun spot on the map, learn the course (the gates are the line), and win once per location. A nimble drone and a clean racing line beat raw speed.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Enter races around Leonida — street, off-road, water and air all count as different races. Twenty wins across twenty distinct events is the target, so vary the events rather than grinding one.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal at a fishing challenge. Find Cal, take his fishing challenge, and out-fish him. Watch the tension meter — reel steady and do not snap the line.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish an arcade game. Walk into any arcade, pick a cabinet and play it to the end. Any game counts.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Play Andy's stranger strand to its end — the last mission in his chain pops this.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Finish Kenton's stranger strand.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish Billy's stranger strand.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands around Leonida. Stranger missions appear as ? markers — work through eight full strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and two more). Each strand ends with a final mission; the trophy pops when the eighth strand closes.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Finish Randy's stranger strand.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Finish Tyrone's stranger strand.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida (18 spots). This is the one trophy reported as possibly missable — PowerPyx and GTABase both flag it. Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter and meditate at every spot you find as you go; do not leave them all for post-game. If a spot is tied to a story window, a manual save is your only way back.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand leads you to a rare animal — track it, take the shot, and bring it in. This is the stranger mission for Bret.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida — collect full sets of three. Track which sets you have finished; the trophy pops on the third completed set.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK is the in-world photo and tagging activity — use it at 100 distinct spots. Work through the map methodically, region by region, so you do not lose track of where you have been.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the small feats the game tracks (stunts, kills, driving, exploration). Fifty completions across any mix counts — play broadly and they accumulate.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape. Get to 4 stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the heat dies. A fast car and a good hiding spot (alley, tunnel, water) make it manageable.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row with your partner, keeping the wanted level alive the whole time. Plan a route with three close shops, move fast, and do not let the heat drop between hits.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every distinct vehicle you drive counts toward the 100. Steal, borrow and test-drive widely — variety is the point, so do not stick to one car.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus with a group of enemies close together and drop five before it ends. A crowded firefight and a high-damage weapon make it far easier.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. The description points to the airport — leaving VCIA in a hurry, outside a mission, is the likely trigger. No unlock method is publicly confirmed yet, so treat this as unconfirmed and check back once the community pins it down.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. The Rhino is the tank — this one involves driving or surviving in one. No unlock method is publicly confirmed yet; the name points at the Rhino, so look for a tank-related feat.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store, go in quiet, avoid cameras and guards, and get out clean. Stealth approach — no alarms, no witnesses.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Hit five bank vaults and get away clean each time. Plan the getaway before you go in; a fast car parked close by is half the job.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, crack it open and escape the response. Blow the doors or force the driver out, grab the cash, and lose the heat.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit every named region of the map. Drive the highways, take the back roads, and check the map for greyed-out areas — the trophy pops when the last region registers.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Every gang runs an illegal operation somewhere — hit one per gang. Learn which gang holds which spot, then rob each in turn.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view. A quiet moment — the game rewards stopping to look around.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car straight through a showroom window. Pick a showroom, line up, and floor it through the glass.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley and finish a game. Follow through on the throw — the name is the hint.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. No unlock method is publicly confirmed yet. PowerPyx reports it needs max Strength on both characters; Push Square reports it needs max body fat (Overweight). The two guides disagree, so do not commit to one method until the community confirms it.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). This is a story-choice trophy — a decision you make in the story. No unlock method is publicly confirmed yet; the specific choice is not documented, so play the story and watch for a decision point.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The name suggests failing something, then succeeding on the second try. No unlock method is publicly confirmed yet.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The name and description point at something strange — the community reads it as a UFO or easter-egg moment. No unlock method is publicly confirmed yet.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Hit pedestrians with a melee attack while driving past. A drive-by with a bat or similar weapon — line up a group and swing as you pass.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — launder them through your contacts to clean the cash. $250,000 laundered in total is the target; keep robbing and laundering.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, weapons, food and gear across Leonida's shops — $100,000 total spend. It adds up naturally if you shop as you play.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every garage property on the market. Check the property listings and work through them — each purchase counts.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the Scooter Bros app and register ten different vehicles to it. Any ten vehicles count.
trophies.name: On the Spot
